### 💡 Intuition & Approach
Implement mean categorical cross-entropy in Triton with stable row-wise log-sum-exp and atomic loss accumulation.

### ⚡ Python Reference Implementation
```python
import numpy as np

def triton_cross_entropy(logits: list, targets: list) -> float:
    l = np.array(logits, dtype=float)
    t = np.array(targets, dtype=int)
    m = np.max(l, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
    log_p = l - m - np.log(np.sum(np.exp(l - m), axis=-1, keepdims=True))
    if l.ndim == 1: return round(float(-log_p[t]), 6)
    return round(float(-np.mean([log_p[i, t[i]] for i in range(len(t))])), 6)
```
